title: Controls endpoint registry
description: Binds HTTP routes to resource types, identity locations, masking policies and resource-attribute sources. Resource type and identity authority comes from this registry, never from the request payload.

defaultUnregistered.description: Behaviour for routes that match no registry entry. Deny is the required production setting.

id.description: Stable identifier used in decision logs and metrics.

service.description: Owning service. Used by the bundle renderer to produce per-service bundles.

path.description: Exact segment-wise path template. '{name}' captures one segment. Regex and wildcards are not permitted.

action.description: Defaults from the HTTP method when omitted.

resourceSource.description: Where resource attributes come from. pip = Attribute Service; body = request payload; both = payload overlaid with PIP attributes.

attributes.description: Field projection requested from the PIP. Never request fields the policy does not use.

maskErrors.description: Apply masking to error responses as well.

freshness.description: cached ignores replica lag; fresh bypasses the sidecar cache; deny-on-stale returns 503 when the PIP's lag exceeds maxStalenessSeconds.

maxStalenessSeconds.description: Lag bound for fresh/deny-on-stale endpoints. Zero means the engine default (5s).

selfDescribing.description: When true, payload _type/_id are required to match this entry or the request is rejected.

path.description: Dot path into the JSON body, e.g. $.debitAccount.id.
